openings.claim: Removable rim clips could transfer sideways load through hatch-edge stops, reducing seal-friction dependence while retaining vertically only enough to prevent escape. Make two opposed assemblies from paired supplied strips, bolts and padded jaws; bolt shanks serve as stops only where actual rim access/hatch geometry permit. Remove clips completely for inspection; tether externally with supplied cord.
openings.discriminator: Versus stronger corner clamping, lightly retained positive stops should resist 20 N without increased pressure associated with opposite-corner lift. Slip, hatch escape, or necessary tightening producing rocking defeats functional separation. Supplied left-corner pressure lifted the opposite corner 2 mm in three trials.
openings.probe: Measure rim-underside access, edge clearances and stop directions. Reject fabrication unless two padded clips capture the rim and constrain the supplied pull direction without touching/trapping the seal. Fabricate only if feasible within ninety minutes. Within twenty observation minutes, run two tighter-clamp rival trials first, including its disturbed final closure; these assess sensitivity, not durability. Then perform ten clip closure/pull trials, reopening each cycle and timing one technician. Record position before/after each 20 N pull, corner lift and visible seal damage. Place the supplied 1 mm card at the marked right contact for the tenth/final closure. Require every valued outcome; stop upon damage.
openings.uncertainty: Indispensable underside access and strip-spanning jaw geometry are unprovided. Four bolts/four pads must suffice. Removal, external cord routing and reinstallation must permit unobstructed inspection, reopening within thirty seconds and ten trials within twenty minutes. Stop locations must constrain the supplied pull direction with compliance below 1 mm. Damage stopping proves no feasibility.

lineage.reason: Protected relation, rival/defeat conditions, screened probe, resource caveats, uncertain fit and assumptions retained.

decision: Conditional fabrication-screened probe. Retain existing hatch/rim/seal; never drill, cut, glue or permanently deform hatch/trough. No powered mechanism; loose parts recoverable; full marked opening unobstructed; no new visible seal tears. After ten cycles: within 1 mm of marked position, withstand 20 N sideways, reopen within thirty seconds. Disturbance waives only seal-contact continuity; unknown geometry may prevent fabrication.
